name: Local isolator plan mark
summary: Plan mark for a local isolating switch placed beside fixed equipment for safe maintenance.
description: Local isolators are placed within sight of motors, air-conditioning units, pumps and fans so maintenance staff can isolate and lock the supply. Plans draw a small switch box with an isolation mark or the letters ISO beside the equipment it serves, sometimes with a lock indication.

The mark tells the installer to provide a device rated for isolation and, where required, lockable in the off position. Pole count follows the supply: three-pole or four-pole for three-phase plant. It does not specify utilisation category or whether the device can switch motor load. Those are in the schedule.
readingNotes: Check it is within sight of the equipment.
Confirm pole count and locking provision.
distinction: A switched socket outlet is not an isolator; this plan mark designates an isolation-rated device.
